about.title: About Flyin
about.body: Flyin is a leading online travel agency in the region, dedicated to making travel simple, affordable and enjoyable. Since our founding we have helped millions of travellers discover the world — from quick city breaks to once-in-a-lifetime journeys. We partner with hundreds of airlines and thousands of hotels to bring you great prices, backed by 24/7 customer support and flexible services like FlexiFly and EzCancel.

items.q: How do I book a flight?
items.a: Search for your route and dates on the home page, compare the available flights, select the one you like and complete the secure checkout.

items.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
items.a: Yes. With FlexiFly you can change your dates, and with EzCancel you can cancel and receive a refund of up to 90% before departure.
We accept major credit and debit cards, and you can also pay later in easy installments on eligible bookings.
Absolutely. All transactions are encrypted and processed through secure payment gateways.

items.q: How do I contact customer support?
items.a: Our team is available 24/7 by phone, WhatsApp and email — see the Support page for details.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: This demo Privacy Policy explains, in general terms, how a travel platform like Flyin would collect and use information such as your name, contact details and booking preferences to provide its services. In this demonstration application no real personal data is collected, stored or shared with third parties. In a production deployment this page would describe data collection, cookies, retention, your rights and how to contact the data protection team.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: These demo Terms of Use outline the general conditions under which a travel booking service would be provided — including booking, pricing, cancellation and the responsibilities of both the traveller and the platform. This is a demonstration application; bookings made here are not real and no contract is formed. A production deployment would include full contractual terms, liability limitations and governing law.
